installation.evidence: Owner confirms update installed/opened without changing account; devicectl confirms bundle ID and build at 14:18

ask_to_buy.observed: Pending state with full=false on build 33. Account corrected; owner ultimately reports no pending requests in Sandbox settings. No approval or rejection observed.
ask_to_buy.decision: Owner requests skipping this case and continuing with refund.

refund.observed: Owner confirms Apple refund sheet opens but shows No se puede conectar before reason form; same result after switching network. Readback remains purchased/full=true/source=store; no revocation observed.
refund.scope: Native Sandbox only; request submission is not proof of revocation.
refund.next_step: Retry native Sandbox refund in later session; no code cause confirmed.
refund.similar_report: https://developer.apple.com/forums/thread/846103 (third-party firsthand report; not confirmation of this case cause)

restore_without_purchase_cache.scope: Purchase-cache reset in existing installation; does not prove whole-app clean installation.
restore_without_purchase_cache.evidence: App closed; primary entitlement.json replaced with valid none/full=false and byte-verified. Owner presses Restaurar compras and confirms full restored with pet, coins, wardrobe and photos intact. Readback confirms purchased/full=true/source=store.
restore_without_purchase_cache.limitations: Existing installation; backup entitlement retained. Not a whole-app clean installation.

other_language_and_currency.observed: Owner renews Sandbox session after temporary storefront change to United States, selects English, and confirms English screen with price in dollars on build 34.
other_language_and_currency.limitations: Manual spot check of English and USD; not linguistic acceptance of all 11 variants. Exact price amount not recorded.

failed_connection_purchase.observed: Owner attempts Buy with airplane mode and Wi-Fi off: error, remains free. Reconnects and presses Restore; full version and pet, coins, wardrobe and photos recovered. Readback purchased/full=true/source=store.
failed_connection_purchase.limitations: Connection failure only; native interrupted approval, forced billing failures and closing during confirmation not exercised.

interrupted_purchase.scope: Native interrupted transaction or close during confirmation; not covered by the connection failure test.

whole_app_clean_reinstallation.scope: Not performed to preserve the owner's only game installation; purchase-primary reset is narrower.

data_handling.purchase_cache_cleanup: Completed: both original purchase files restored and byte-for-byte verified against private backups before reopening.
data_handling.account_cleanup: Completed: Spain saved and verified in App Store Connect. Owner confirms Ask to Buy and interruptions off, Sandbox signed out, normal Media & Purchases account restored, Spanish selected, full version and game/photos preserved.
